statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-12590 is a low-severity resource-exhaustion issue in body-parser <1.20.6 (fixed in 1.20.6). The 1.20.3 resolution in this image comes from express 4.x, which pins body-parser to exactly 1.20.3; pnpm's override version selectors (neither a `body-parser@1` range nor an exact `body-parser@1.20.3` selector) match express's exact pin, so the transitive resolution cannot be forced to 1.20.6 without an unscoped override that would also disturb the fixed body-parser 2.x line. The body-parser 2.x consumers are already pinned to the fixed 2.3.0 via pnpm overrides. Assessing whether the express 4.x body-parser code path is reachable at runtime in the self-hosted webapp and tracking upstream express for a body-parser 1.20.6 bump.
